title: MediaCollection
description: MEDIA-SPEC-01 (media design section 7). A person's ordered references to media items: liked, watch later, the queue, a playlist, the watchlist, pins. One liked, one watch_later and one queue per person exist by construction. The list record stays for text lists (its items are text with a checked state; these are references with order, status and a pointer). PODCAST-PORT-03: a filter is a saved episode filter; its items stay empty and its rules say which episodes match. VIDEO-LD-04: family_picks is one shared household collection where anyone adds and everyone votes; the top pick plays next.

media_kind.description: MEDIA-PARITY-02. What a playlist holds. A record without it is a music playlist.

members.description: MEDIA-PARITY-02. People other than the owner who may add items to a shared playlist. The owner always may. Empty by default; it grants adding only, and who can see the playlist stays with shared_to.

cover_file_id.description: MEDIA-PARITY-02. A household file used as the playlist's cover picture. Null draws the cover from the first items.

pointer.description: The queue's current entry (an index into items).

shared_to.description: Null is private. A child's collections are never shared outside the household.

rules.description: Null for every kind but filter. For kind filter, the saved episode filter: every rule given must match (AND). Omitted rules do not restrict. Evaluated by the hub against the person's own progress and the shows they can see.

in_progress.description: True keeps episodes started but not finished.

saved.description: True keeps episodes saved to the household file store.

released_within_days.description: Only episodes published in the last N days.

deleted_at.description: TRASH-01. Set when a person moves the record to the household trash; null while live. A trashed record is hidden everywhere and restorable until trash_until.

trash_until.description: TRASH-01. When the trash purges the record for good; set together with deleted_at.
